authenticity_review: Multiple AI generation artifacts are present at varying severities. The tandem bicycle exhibits fusion (severity 3) where the checkered fabric pattern merges indistinctly with rear wheel spokes and axle, obscuring mechanical structure. The upright violin shows structural collapse (severity 2) in the string/bridge region, appearing as a solid black mass rather than four distinct strings over a bridge. The black bicycle displays perspective distortion (severity 2) with warped rear rack and flattened chainring geometry inconsistent with real bicycle manufacturing. The red bicycle has a texture anomaly (severity 1) with unnaturally uniform glitter lacking realistic specular variation. perceptual_quality_auditor found no graphics-level distortions (noise/compression/blur), confirming these are structural/semantic artifacts rather than rendering issues. The combination of fusion, structural collapse, and perspective errors indicates moderate-to-significant generation quality problems.
